meta.name: writing-skills
meta.description: Use when creating new skills, editing existing skills, or verifying skills work before deployment

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 创建、编辑和验证技能，确保部署前正常工作
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你需要创建或维护自己的技能
copy.tagline_en: Create, edit, and verify skills before deployment
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to create or maintain your own skills

howto.what: 装好后，Claude 会按“测试驱动文档”的方式创建或修改技能：先观察没有技能时 AI 的表现，再写说明文档并验证它能纠正问题；同时严格遵守技能文件的格式规范，比如描述只写“何时用”而不是“做什么”。
howto.when: 当你要创建新技能、编辑现有技能，或部署前想验证技能是否正常时触发。

say.text: 我要新建一个技能，先帮我想几个测试场景
say.note: 会先进入测试驱动流程，而不是直接写文档。

say.text: 帮我检查这个 SKILL.md 的 description 有没有写成流程摘要
say.note: 会按规范检查触发条件写法。

say.text: 编辑一下我的技能，但改之前先跑一次失败测试
say.note: 确保遵守铁律：没有失败测试就不改。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude creates or edits skills using test-driven documentation: it runs baseline scenarios, writes the skill file, then verifies it fixes agent behavior. It also enforces format rules, e.g. the description states when to use, not what the skill does.
howto.when_en: Triggered when creating a new skill, editing an existing skill, or verifying a skill works before deployment.

say_en.text: I want to create a skill. First, give me some test scenarios.
say_en.note: Starts the test-driven flow instead of writing docs directly.

say_en.text: Check if this SKILL.md description summarizes the workflow instead of triggers.
say_en.note: Validates the description against the specification.

say_en.text: Edit my skill, but run a failing test before changing it.
